subject: physics
question_text: The absolute temperature of a gas is increased 3 times. What will be the increase in rms velocity of the gas molecule?

verification.note: Asked in TS Inter I-Year Physics Paper-I, March 2019 (Q10), March 2020 (Q10) and March 2025 (Q9) — three of the seven papers held. Section A, 2 marks each time. The 1+1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question text itself is sourced from those papers. `appearances` is deliberately left empty — a separate reviewed tagging pass fills it, and a hand-written tag here would be an invented claim. Arithmetic hand-checked: v_rms = √(3RT/M), so v_rms ∝ √T; tripling T gives v′ = √3 v = 1.7320508 v, and the INCREASE asked for is v′ − v = (√3 − 1)v = 0.7320508 v, that is 73.205% ≈ 73.2% of the original. The card states the new value and the increase side by side so the two cannot be confused.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The rms speed goes as √T
lines: For a gas of molar mass M at absolute
Only T changes here, so the rms velocity
steps.margin_note: First mark. Write v_rms ∝ √T before any number is worked out.
steps.why: The temperature sits under a square root, so multiplying T by 3 multiplies v_rms by √3 and not by 3. Every later line of the answer follows from that one square root.
common_mistakes: Multiplying the rms velocity by 3 because the temperature was multiplied by 3. The square root makes it √3.

recall.must_convey: That v rms is proportional to root T, so tripling T multiplies the speed by root three.
accept: v rms is proportional to root T
square root of three RT by M

steps.memory_tip: Temperature sits under the square root: three times T gives √3 times the speed.

steps.label: The increase
lines: The question asks for the INCREASE, not
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Subtract the original speed: 1.732 v is the new value, 0.732 v is the increase.
steps.why: The new speed is 1.732 v and the increase is 0.732 v. The two numbers differ by exactly one whole v, and writing the first when the question asks for the second is the usual way this mark is lost.
common_mistakes: Answering 1.732 v or 173.2%. That is the NEW value; the increase is 0.732 v.
Writing the increase as √3 v without subtracting the original speed.

recall.must_convey: That the increase is root three minus one times v, about 0.732 v or 73.2 percent.
accept: zero point seven three two v
reject: one point seven three two v is the increase

steps.memory_tip: √3 = 1.732. Take away the 1 that was already there: the increase is 0.732 v.

insider_note: Asked in three of the seven recent papers, and every time it asks for the INCREASE — writing 1.732 v answers a question that was not set.
